units.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic finite n≥0 and finite horizon T≥0, let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)) and H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n). Write rtime(live(a,z))=a and rtime(stopped)=0. Define the measurable ordered simplex Δ_n(T)={t∈ℝ^n:0<t_1<⋯<t_n<T}; its subtype carries m_n, the comap of product Lebesgue volume along inclusion. For t∈Δ_n(T), put s_0=0,s_i=t_i, z_0=z₀ and z_i=S_rΦ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1)) for 1≤i≤n. Define K_n(t)_j=live(s_j,z_j). Define qReal_n(t)=∏_(i=1)^n [λ_r(Φ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1))) exp(−Λ_(z_(i−1))(s_i−s_(i−1)))] and q_n=ofReal(qReal_n). Here the literal Lean definitions use toNNReal on times and elapsed times; these agree with the displayed nonnegative values on the simplex. Let A_n(T) be the abstract-history set in which all n+1 records are live, their read times are strictly increasing, and each postinitial read time is below T. A_n(T) does not itself constrain the initial record time. Set B_n(T)=H_n^(-1)(A_n(T)) and obs_n(w)_i=rtime(H_n(w)_(i+1)); actual H_n(w)_0 is always live(0,z₀). Then Δ_n(T) and A_n(T) are Borel. For fixed n,T, K_n and q_n are jointly Borel in (y,r,z₀,t). For every y,r,z₀, H_n,obs_n and B_n(T) are Borel, and qReal_n(t)≥0 for every simplex point. For every raw w∈B_n(T), there exists t∈Δ_n(T) with t=obs_n(w) and H_n(w)=K_n(t), as complete tagged histories. The exact unnormalized law is (H_n)_*(P restricted to B_n(T))=(K_n)_*(q_n m_n). For every Borel F:Hist_n→[0,∞], ∫_(B_n(T))F(H_n(w))P(dw)=∫_(Δ_n(T))F(K_n(t))q_n(t)m_n(dt). Moreover ∫q_n dm_n=P(B_n(T))≤1. This includes n=0,T=0, zero hazard and extended-valued tests; there is no boundedness, integrability or positive-event-mass assumption. This is the strict first-n-prefix law, without a final survival factor, and is not a raw exact-n event-count law. It is an attributed ASTIS completion of the finite ordered iteration ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), with joint Borel construction from Appendix A.2. The dimension-zero and ENNReal-test extensions are explicit ASTIS extensions. steps.title: Build the Borel geometry and a nonnegative density
steps.text: The simplex is a finite intersection of strict inequalities between coordinate maps. Reading a live time and returning zero on the stopped tag is Borel; the live tag is a measurable summand. Thus the complete-history guard is Borel. Reuse the actual harmonic-flow, reflection/rate and integrated-hazard theorems. Finite induction through the bounce-after-flow update makes every prescribed state jointly Borel in y,r,z₀ and time coordinates. Pair with the nonnegative time coordinates to obtain K; finite products and exp/ofReal give q. Each rate is √η times a nonnegative positive part and each exponential is positive, so every factor and the real finite product are nonnegative.

private theorem measurable_cons_zero (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Measurable (fun t : Fin n → ℝ => (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j) := by
  induction j using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simpa only [Fin.cons_zero] using (measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : Fin n → ℝ => (0 : ℝ)))
  | succ i => simpa only [Fin.cons_succ] using (measurable_pi_apply i : Measurable (fun t : Fin n → ℝ => t i))

private theorem simplex_measurable (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    MeasurableSet {t : Fin n → ℝ |
      StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)} := by
  simp only [StrictMono, Set.ofPred_and, Set.ofPred_forall]
  apply MeasurableSet.inter
  · exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => MeasurableSet.iInter fun j =>
      MeasurableSet.iInter fun _ => measurableSet_lt (measurable_cons_zero n i) (measurable_cons_zero n j)
  · exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => measurableSet_lt (measurable_pi_apply i) measurable_const

private def readTime {Z : Type*} (r : (ℝ≥0 × Z) ⊕ Unit) : ℝ :=
  match r with
  | Sum.inl q => q.1
  | Sum.inr _ => 0

private theorem readTime_measurable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] :
    Measurable (@readTime Z) := by
  apply Measurable.sumElim
  · exact measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp measurable_fst
  · exact measurable_const

private theorem live_measurable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] :
    MeasurableSet {r : (ℝ≥0 × Z) ⊕ Unit | ∃ a, r = Sum.inl a} := by
  have heq : {r : (ℝ≥0 × Z) ⊕ Unit | ∃ a, r = Sum.inl a} = Set.range Sum.inl := by
    ext r
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_range, eq_comm]
  rw [heq]
  exact measurableSet_range_inl

private theorem history_guard_measurable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    MeasurableSet {h : Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × Z) ⊕ Unit) |
      (∀ j, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × Z, h j = Sum.inl a) ∧
      StrictMono (fun j => readTime (h j)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n, readTime (h i.succ) < (T : ℝ)} := by
  simp only [StrictMono, Set.ofPred_and, Set.ofPred_forall]
  apply MeasurableSet.inter
  · exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun j => live_measurable.preimage (measurable_pi_apply j)
  · apply MeasurableSet.inter
    · exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => MeasurableSet.iInter fun j =>
        MeasurableSet.iInter fun _ => measurableSet_lt
          (readTime_measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
          (readTime_measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply j))
    · exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i => measurableSet_lt
        (readTime_measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply i.succ)) measurable_const

    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)

      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)

    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef

          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>

            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →

      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
    let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
        (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
    let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
    let Hist : ℕ → Type _ := fun n => Fin (n + 1) → Rec
    let readTime : Rec → ℝ := fun r => match r with
      | Sum.inl q => (q.1 : ℝ)
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
    let Δ : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun n T =>
      {t | StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)}

      Measure.comap (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val) (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))

        Prefix n T → Fin (n + 1) → (E × E) := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      Fin.induction z₀ (fun i z =>
        S xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc) z))
    let K : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Hist n := fun y xRef z₀ n T t j =>
      Sum.inl (Real.toNNReal ((Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j), zAt y xRef z₀ n T t j)
    let qReal : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → ℝ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>

        rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)
          (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)) *
        Real.exp (-Λ y xRef (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)
          (Real.toNNReal (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)))

steps.text: Take w in B_n and read its postinitial times into s. The actual zeroth record is live(0,z₀); the guard supplies strict increase and s_i<T, hence s lies in the simplex. steps.title: Split exactly the next strict-prefix event

steps.text: Assume the test identity at n. Apply it to the Borel J_F produced by the actual recurrence. The resulting integrand is J_F(K_n(s))q_n(s). At K_n(s), the next-event density is the indicator of s_n<u<T times ρ(z_n,u−s_n). Move the finite nonnegative scalar q_n(s)=ofReal(qReal_n(s)) inside the nonnegative integral, restrict to that open interval, and use the exact append and product identities. The result is F(K_(n+1)(s,u))q_(n+1)(s,u). The subtype Tonelli equality turns the two integrals into the integral over Δ_(n+1). Joint Borel K and q ensure the composed test is Borel. Together with the zero-event base this proves the formula for every n, without boundedness or integrability.

private theorem law_and_mass_of_all_tests {Ω X H : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace H]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (m : Measure X)
    (B : Set Ω) (history : Ω → H) (K : X → H) (q : X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hH : Measurable history) (hK : Measurable K) (hq : Measurable q)
    (htest : ∀ F : H → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F →
      (∫⁻ w in B, F (history w) ∂P) = ∫⁻ t, F (K t) * q t ∂m) :
    Measure.map history (P.restrict B) = Measure.map K (m.withDensity q) ∧
      (∫⁻ t, q t ∂m) = P B ∧ P B ≤ 1 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, prob_le_one⟩
  · apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
    intro F hF
    rw [lintegral_map hF hH, lintegral_map hF hK,
      lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul m hq (g := fun t => F (K t)) (hF.comp hK)]
    exact (htest F hF).trans (lintegral_congr fun _ => mul_comm _ _)
  · have h := htest (fun _ => 1) measurable_const
    simpa only [one_mul, lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ,
      Set.univ_inter] using h.symm

theorem actual_ordered_prefix_law
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    actual_ordered_prefix_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
      ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
    MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
      (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
        Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
      (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
  let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
    match r with
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
    | Sum.inl a =>
      if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
        Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
  let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
    Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
  let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
      (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
    fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
  let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
  let Hist : ℕ → Type _ := fun n => Fin (n + 1) → Rec
  let readTime : Rec → ℝ := fun r => match r with
    | Sum.inl q => (q.1 : ℝ)
    | Sum.inr _ => 0
  let Δ : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun n T =>
    {t | StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)}
  let Prefix : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Type := fun n T => {t : Fin n → ℝ // t ∈ Δ n T}
  let m : (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Measure (Prefix n T) := fun n T =>
    Measure.comap (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val) (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))
  let zAt : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
      Prefix n T → Fin (n + 1) → (E × E) := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
    Fin.induction z₀ (fun i z =>
      S xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc) z))
  let K : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
      Prefix n T → Hist n := fun y xRef z₀ n T t j =>
    Sum.inl (Real.toNNReal ((Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j), zAt y xRef z₀ n T t j)
  let qReal : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
      Prefix n T → ℝ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
    ∏ i : Fin n,
      rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)
        (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)) *
      Real.exp (-Λ y xRef (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)
        (Real.toNNReal (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)))
  let q : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
      Prefix n T → ℝ≥0∞ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
    ENNReal.ofReal (qReal y xRef z₀ n T t)
  let A : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Hist n) := fun n T =>
    {h | (∀ j, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), h j = Sum.inl a) ∧
      StrictMono (fun j => readTime (h j)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n, readTime (h i.succ) < (T : ℝ)}
  change ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ T : ℝ≥0,
      MeasurableSet (Δ n T) ∧ MeasurableSet (A n T) ∧
      Measurable (fun p : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × Prefix n T =>
        K p.1.1.1 p.1.1.2 p.1.2 n T p.2) ∧
      Measurable (fun p : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × Prefix n T =>
        q p.1.1.1 p.1.1.2 p.1.2 n T p.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist n := history y xRef z₀ n
        let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := H ⁻¹' A n T
        let obs : (ℕ → ℝ) → Fin n → ℝ := fun w i => readTime (H w i.succ)
        Measurable H ∧ MeasurableSet B ∧ Measurable obs ∧
        (∀ t : Prefix n T, 0 ≤ qReal y xRef z₀ n T t) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, ∃ t : Prefix n T, t.val = obs w ∧ H w = K y xRef z₀ n T t) ∧
        Measure.map H (P.restrict B) =
          Measure.map (K y xRef z₀ n T) ((m n T).withDensity (q y xRef z₀ n T)) ∧
        (∀ F : Hist n → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F →
          (∫⁻ w in B, F (H w) ∂P) =
            ∫⁻ t : Prefix n T, F (K y xRef z₀ n T t) * q y xRef z₀ n T t ∂m n T) ∧
        (∫⁻ t : Prefix n T, q y xRef z₀ n T t ∂m n T) = P B ∧
        P B ≤ 1)
  intro n T
  have hg := ordered_prefix_borel_data hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη n T
  refine ⟨hg.1, hg.2.1, hg.2.2.1, hg.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro y xRef z₀
  dsimp only
  have h91 := AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualAbsoluteNextEventTime.actual_absolute_next_event_time_law
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y xRef z₀ n
  have hHist : Measurable (history y xRef z₀ n) := h91.1
  have hB : MeasurableSet (history y xRef z₀ n ⁻¹' A n T) := hg.2.1.preimage hHist
  have hread : readTime = @AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualOrderedPrefix.readTime (E × E) := by
    funext r; cases r <;> rfl
  have hObs : Measurable (fun w : ℕ → ℝ => fun i : Fin n =>
      readTime (history y xRef z₀ n w i.succ)) := by
    rw [hread]
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro i
    exact readTime_measurable.comp ((measurable_pi_apply i.succ).comp hHist)
  have hparams : Measurable (fun t : Prefix n T => (((y, xRef), z₀), t)) :=
    measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id
  have hKjoint : Measurable (fun p : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × Prefix n T =>
      K p.1.1.1 p.1.1.2 p.1.2 n T p.2) := hg.2.2.1
  have hqjoint : Measurable (fun p : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × Prefix n T =>
      q p.1.1.1 p.1.1.2 p.1.2 n T p.2) := hg.2.2.2.1
  have hK := hKjoint.comp hparams
  have hq := hqjoint.comp hparams
  dsimp only [Function.comp_def] at hK hq
  have htest := actual_prefix_all_integrals hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη n T y xRef z₀
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.1
  have hclosure := law_and_mass_of_all_tests P (m n T)
    (history y xRef z₀ n ⁻¹' A n T) (history y xRef z₀ n)
    (K y xRef z₀ n T) (q y xRef z₀ n T) hHist hK hq htest
  refine ⟨hHist, hB, hObs, hg.2.2.2.2 y xRef z₀, ?_, hclosure.1, htest,
    hclosure.2.1, hclosure.2.2⟩
  exact actual_prefix_identification hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη n T y xRef z₀

units.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic finite n≥0 and finite horizon T≥0, let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)) and H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n). Write rtime(live(a,z))=a and rtime(stopped)=0. Define the measurable ordered simplex Δ_n(T)={t∈ℝ^n:0<t_1<⋯<t_n<T}; its subtype carries m_n, the comap of product Lebesgue volume along inclusion. For t∈Δ_n(T), put s_0=0,s_i=t_i, z_0=z₀ and z_i=S_rΦ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1)) for 1≤i≤n. Define K_n(t)_j=live(s_j,z_j). Define qReal_n(t)=∏_(i=1)^n [λ_r(Φ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1))) exp(−Λ_(z_(i−1))(s_i−s_(i−1)))] and q_n=ofReal(qReal_n). Here the literal Lean definitions use toNNReal on times and elapsed times; these agree with the displayed nonnegative values on the simplex. Let A_n(T) be the abstract-history set in which all n+1 records are live, their read times are strictly increasing, and each postinitial read time is below T. A_n(T) does not itself constrain the initial record time. Set B_n(T)=H_n^(-1)(A_n(T)) and obs_n(w)_i=rtime(H_n(w)_(i+1)); actual H_n(w)_0 is always live(0,z₀). Then Δ_n(T) and A_n(T) are Borel. For fixed n,T, K_n and q_n are jointly Borel in (y,r,z₀,t). For every y,r,z₀, H_n,obs_n and B_n(T) are Borel, and qReal_n(t)≥0 for every simplex point. For every raw w∈B_n(T), there exists t∈Δ_n(T) with t=obs_n(w) and H_n(w)=K_n(t), as complete tagged histories. The exact unnormalized law is (H_n)_*(P restricted to B_n(T))=(K_n)_*(q_n m_n). For every Borel F:Hist_n→[0,∞], ∫_(B_n(T))F(H_n(w))P(dw)=∫_(Δ_n(T))F(K_n(t))q_n(t)m_n(dt). Moreover ∫q_n dm_n=P(B_n(T))≤1. This includes n=0,T=0, zero hazard and extended-valued tests; there is no boundedness, integrability or positive-event-mass assumption. This is the strict first-n-prefix law, without a final survival factor, and is not a raw exact-n event-count law. It is an attributed ASTIS completion of the finite ordered iteration ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), with joint Borel construction from Appendix A.2. The dimension-zero and ENNReal-test extensions are explicit ASTIS extensions. Terminal survival, endpoint/count identification, the full path-functional A.7 expansion, restart/Markovness, invariance, hypocoercivity, implementation errors, expected costs and full paper/composition remain outside this result.
